name: Zoe
source:
An aspiring lawyer, Zoe is a tough person to deal with at times, especially when she deems you’re being lazy or not living up to your potential. Leanne has gotten to know that aspect extensively, even til this day, though you and the rest of the girls aren’t strangers to her brashness either.

*Freely adapted from official site.*
